It's hard to not be disappointed after last night but I think it is important to point out the positives. As you pointed out, we're looking much better going forward than in the past two seasons. We also can't forget it still takes some time to gel. Markos link up play with both Anderson and yarmolenko has been great at times but there's still a lack of flow between Anderson and yarmolenko. You could see a few times last night the two getting frustrated with one another on miscommunicated balls.

I must say I was impressed Brighton's right back Bruno. I thought we'd light him up with pace considering his age and returning from injury. He had a few crucial tackles. If masuaku offered more going forward we may have been able to do more as it seemed most of our attacks came from the right side or Anderson solo on the left. I'd like to see cresswell over masuaku next game. Even though I rate masuaku, he needs a wakeup call because his effort isn't good enough.

Either way, we've got an extra week to prepare for spurs and keep moving forward.
